## Anomaly Localization (If Detected)
No variable or operation was found where the declared business context (C_source) diverges from the consumed business context (C_target) while technical typing remains unchanged. Full trace below:

- i_2 (R1, series, 100Ω) + i_3 (R2, series, 150Ω) --op_1(add)--> o_7 "Series resistance, R1+R2" = 250Ω. Semantically correct (series+series -> series-sum).
- i_4 (R3, parallel, 300Ω) × i_5 (R4, parallel, 600Ω) --op_2(multiply)--> o_8 "R3×R4" = 180000. Correct numerator for parallel formula.
- i_4 + i_5 --op_3(add)--> o_9 "R3+R4" = 900. Correct denominator for parallel formula.
- o_8 / o_9 --op_4(divide)--> o_10 "Parallel resistance, Rparallel" = 200Ω. Matches R3||R4 = (R3*R4)/(R3+R4).
- o_7 (series sum) + o_10 (parallel combo) --op_5(add)--> o_11 "Total resistance, Rtotal" = 450Ω. Correct series-parallel topology (R1+R2 in series with R3||R4).
- i_6 (Supply voltage, 120V) / o_11 (Rtotal) --op_6(divide)--> o_12 "Total current, I" = 0.2666666666666667A. Ohm's law, correctly labeled.
- o_12 (I) × i_6 (V) --op_7(multiply)--> o_13 "Total power dissipated, P=I×V" = 32.00000000000000W. Consistent with P=IV.
- o_12 (I) ^ i_14 (n=2) --op_8(pow)--> o_15 "I²" = 0.07111111111111113. Correctly labeled square of current.
- o_15 (I²) × o_11 (Rtotal) --op_9(multiply)--> o_16 "Total power cross-check, P=I²×Rtotal" = 32.00000000000001W. Matches P=I²R cross-check, with the 1-ULP divergence from o_13 explained entirely by MathContext(precision=16, HALF_EVEN) rounding propagation through two independent derivation paths — not by tampering.

No node exhibits a mismatch between its originating descriptor.meta/name and the semantic assumption of the consuming operation. All reused variables (i_4, i_5, i_6, o_11, o_12) are consumed in ways fully consistent with their declared roles (R3/R4 feeding both the parallel product and parallel sum; V feeding both current and power; Rtotal feeding both series-parallel combination and the power cross-check; I feeding both the power and I² calculations).

## Details
This is a physically and semantically coherent series-parallel resistor network computation (R1+R2 in series, combined with R3‖R4 in parallel, driving a load at 120V). Every operation's declared formula (`(a+b)mc`, `(a*b)mc`, `(a/b)mc`, `(a^n)mc`) matches its actual mathematical role as stated in the human-readable descriptor.name of both the operation and its resultId variable — e.g., the divide at op_4 truly computes a parallel-resistance quotient and is labeled as such, not silently relabeled as, say, an efficiency ratio or a different domain entity. There is no `domainType`, `units`, or `taxStatus` metadata anywhere in this graph beyond the descriptive names themselves (all `descriptor.meta` arrays are empty), so there is no metadata-suppression vector to exploit, and the naming trail from root inputs (R1..R4, V) through every intermediate to the two leaf outputs (P via I×V, P via I²×Rtotal) is internally consistent at every hop. Mathematically, all values replay correctly under the stated MathContext (precision 16, HALF_EVEN), including the expected sub-ULP divergence between the two independently-derived power values (32.00000000000000 vs 32.00000000000001), which is the classic, benign signature of two legitimate derivation paths converging under finite precision rather than an injected error.

I did not identify any node where a variable is consumed under a business/domain interpretation that conflicts with the interpretation implied by its origin (e.g., a 'series' resistor being silently fed into a parallel-only formula slot, or current being relabeled and consumed as voltage, or a pre-tax/post-tax-style unannounced reinterpretation). Given the complete absence of domain metadata to spoof and the strict internal consistency of naming and physics across all nine operations, I assess this graph as clean with respect to the specific Semantic Type and Context Cast vector under audit. Confidence is not maximal because the total absence of explicit domain/unit metadata fields (beyond free-text names) somewhat limits how rigorously a hidden semantic substitution could be ruled out purely from structure — a determined adversary with access to only free-text renaming could still attempt a subtler cast that only close domain-expert review of physical units would catch, which is outside what this trace-level audit can fully foreclose.
